notes.title: Dev Log #22 - Hotfix 1.0.1 Patch Notes and Looking Ahead
notes.content: Hotfix 1.0.1 has been deployed to all servers and the client is now available for download. This should fix top user issues like unlocks not unlocking, skill points being consumed without getting the unlocks, the alt-tab hang, vote kicking, and more! For details on what's in this hotfix and to hear about what we're focusing on next, check out [url=https://www.playmidair.com/news/dev-log-22-hotfix-1-0-1-patch-notes-looking-ahead/]Dev Log #22[/url].

notes.title: Dev Log #20 - Build 0.31.0 Highlights, Patch Notes, and More!
notes.content: Proxies, we are moving quickly toward our release target and with this major update comes a host of great content and improvements. The docket today includes the release of the WARDEN weapon, the first showing of the map Orbital, Team Deathmatch, armor and weapon skins, and plenty more! Check out [url=https://www.playmidair.com/news/dev-log-20-build-0-31-0-highlights-patch-notes-and-more/]Dev Log #20 here[/url] and download the update!

notes.title: Dev Log #19 – Build 0.30.0 Highlights, Patch Notes, and Release Update
notes.content:
Build 0.30.0 is now LIVE. We've got v1 of our progression system, a beautiful new fully arted map CTF-Reservoir (previously CTF-Dam), CTF gameplay changes, a brand new main menu/loadout screen background, and release timing updates.

Read about all of these things and more in [url=https://www.playmidair.com/news/dev-log-19-build-0-30-0-highlights-patch-notes-release-update/]Dev Log #19[/url].

notes.title: Welcome to the Midair Closed Beta!
notes.content:
The Midair Closed Beta is now LIVE on Steam Early Access!

Get Midair on Steam here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/439370/Midair/

Check out the trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DroL_YioiOs

[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

While you’re downloading the game, join the [url=https://discord.gg/PlayMidair]Official Midair Discord[/url] server and head to the [url=https://forums.playmidair.com]forums[/url] to give feedback, meet other Midair players, and keep up to date on the latest Midair news.

[h1]Beginner-Friendly Servers[/h1]

We’ve added new servers to help new players find a place to practice and get up to speed with the game. New to the game? Join up on servers labeled “Beginner Friendly” and feel free to ask for help! We’ll try to monitor these servers more closely in particular to make sure there’s a good experience maintained for all.

Are you a veteran Midair player? Feel free to join these servers and help out new players – this is HIGHLY ENCOURAGED! Just make sure to consider their experience while playing and don’t get too competitive. Admins will be around to help remind you. 🙂

[h1]New Website[/h1]

We have a brand new [url=https://www.playmidair.com]website[/url]! Take a look around and please leave feedback in the forums.

[h1]A “Thank You” to the Midair Community[/h1]

We wanted to send out a special thank you to our amazing community for supporting the game and our team up to this point. Every person on the dev team is appreciative of your time and effort playing and giving feedback up through this release (and hopefully beyond!). Your Discord messages, forum posts, and constant feedback is critical to the success of the game.

We would not have been able to do this without you, and you have made Midair better since we entered into Pre-Alpha over a year ago. The game has grown leaps and bounds, and as you’ve seen from the last several dev logs and patches, we’re able to do more and more as we get closer to release.

It’s a super exciting time for Midair and we’re fortunate to have such a passionate, committed community.

Now get out there and play some MIDAIR!
